en.headline: Beautician jailed four years for selling friends to Myanmar scam compound
en.dek: District Court Judge Adriana Noelle Tse Ching described the defendant’s actions as vicious and inhumane after the two women were held for ransom.
body: A Hong Kong beautician has been sentenced to four years in jail for fraud after she lured two friends to Thailand and sold them to a scam compound in Myanmar.

District Court Judge Adriana Noelle Tse Ching said 33-year-old Poon Sum-yi had premeditated the scheme. The two victims, an unemployed woman and a part-time model who were friends of the defendant, were initially invited on a trip to Japan or Canada before being taken to Thailand in late December 2024 and then sold to the Chinese-run KK Park compound for US$54,000.

The court heard the women were held for nearly two weeks. Their families eventually paid a total of more than HK$500,000 to secure their release. The judge noted there were no mitigating factors beyond the guilty plea and said a deterrent sentence was required.
Poon had pleaded guilty to one count of fraud. The case had been adjourned earlier while related appeals were considered.

zh.headline: 美容師誘騙友人賣至緬甸詐騙園區 判囚四年
zh.dek: 區域法院法官謝沈智慧斥被告行為夕毒及泯滅人性，兩名事主被困近兩周後家人支付贖金才獲釋。
body: 一名香港美容師因欺詐罪被判入獄四年，她誘騙兩名友人前往泰國後將她們轉賣至緬甸的詐騙園區。
區域法院法官謝沈智慧指，33歲被告潘心怡預謀犯案。兩名事主分別為失業女子及兼職模特兒，原獲邀同往日本或加拿大，惟於2024年12月底被帶到泰國，其後以5.4萬美元被賣至中國人經營的KK園區。
法庭得悉兩人被困近兩周，家人最終支付合共逾50萬港元才將她們贖回。法官表示除認罪外並無減刑因素，須判處阻嚇性刑罰。
潘早前已承認一項欺詐罪。案件早前曾押後以待相關上訴裁決。
